[SWS_TcpIp_00308] ⌈For static TLS connection assignment a port and optionally an
address is defined for at least one TLS connection, TCP shall check during TCP SYN
(either reception or transmission of SYN) if a port assignment is available for any TLS
connection and if this TLS connection is not in use. If so, the TCP shall check the ports
and automatically assign this TLS connection to the socket if a port matches.⌋
